t: You are looking at Wyndham's Theatre on Charing Cross Road, in the City of Westminster. It was one of two theatres opened by the actor and manager Sir Charles Wyndham. The architect was W. G. R. Sprague, who designed it around 1898. He went on to design six more London theatres by 1916. Inside, it was planned to seat 759 people on three levels, and later refurbishment added a fourth. Of Sprague's surviving London theatres, this is the one listed Grade II*, the middle category, in September 1960. The others are Grade II.
